Score new specimens with a frozen single-sample deployment object

Source: R/singlesample-deploy.R
score_specimen.Rd

Scores one or more incoming specimens using only x_new plus the frozen parameters stored in deployable. No scored batch, co-resident reference cohort, or test-time batch statistic is required.

Usage

score_specimen(deployable, x_new, meta = NULL, detected = NULL, strict = FALSE)

Arguments

deployable

A singlesample_deployable object from deploy_singlesample.

x_new

A single named numeric vector, or a numeric matrix/data frame with one or more specimen rows and feature columns. With an attached preprocessor, supply raw counts or Ct values; Ct character markers are accepted and converted to non-detects.

meta

Optional per-specimen metadata, one row per row of x_new.

detected

Optional logical matrix aligned to x_new (or a named logical vector for one specimen). TRUE means detected before imputation. Supply this mask when preprocessing replaces nondetects by positive values that cannot be distinguished from measured values. No detection status is inferred from scored-batch variation or from a constant specimen profile. With a preprocessor, align this mask to the raw input, including extra columns. It is combined with preprocessing detection by logical AND.

strict

Logical scalar; defaults to FALSE. If TRUE, k-TSP and pair-ratio require every fitted-pair feature, trimmed rCLR requires the frozen training feature universe, and balance ILR requires every frozen balance member. Other routes and custom adapters reject with STRICT_UNSUPPORTED. Existing input guards apply in both modes. Registered custom scorers declaring `strict_support = TRUE` receive the flag and apply their documented strict policy.

Value

Numeric score vector with one value per incoming specimen. For k-TSP, pair-ratio, trimmed-rCLR and balance-ILR panels, the scorer's support attribute is retained; see score_reo_ktsp, score_reo_pairratio, score_ws_rclr_panel and score_ws_balance_ilr. The default preserves each scorer's missing-feature policy. Use strict = TRUE here to require complete support. Invalid strict values raise INVALID_STRICT; missing features raise MISSING_REQUIRED_FEATURES, and absent frozen universe metadata raises MISSING_FITTED_UNIVERSE.

Details

Invalid input raises a singlesample_input_error with machine-readable code and affected rows. Codes include EMPTY_INPUT, INVALID_FEATURE_NAMES, ALL_REQUIRED_ABSENT, ALL_NONDETECT, NONFINITE_REQUIRED_VALUE, EMPTY_FITTED_SUPPORT, CONSTANT_FITTED_SUPPORT, and NO_USABLE_SUPPORT. Required NA, NaN or infinite abundance values are rejected before scoring in both default and strict modes. Raw Ct missing values are converted to non-detects when a Ct preprocessor is attached. A batch containing an invalid row is rejected as a whole. Checks use only each specimen and frozen training information. Positive imputation cannot be recognized without detected or an appropriate frozen nondetect_limit. Refit legacy models to record training support status.
